title: 7S.2c common raw-section write transfer
scope: Avoid the ordinary dx_iface-to-dxfRW deep copy of adapter-owned raw DXF sections during synchronous export, while restoring adapter ownership before return.

change.summary: The ordinary raw-section export route transfers dx_data::rawDxfSections into the synchronous codec write and restores it with a scope guard. Existing copy/rvalue setters and the separate ACDSDATA projection route are unchanged.

generatedControl.formatVersion: AC1032 ASCII and Binary DXF exports
generatedControl.input: Existing valid DIMENSION/picture-block full-conversion control with one generated CUSTOM_SECTION opaque section.
checks: successful ASCII and Binary full conversions emit the custom section and opaque payload
adapter raw-section vector and nested group storage are restored after the synchronous write
focused transfer control checks nested group storage identity across adopt/return without a deep copy

evidenceCeiling: Focused tests establish ownership transfer, restoration, and section emission on the existing valid adapter conversion. They do not establish cross-implementation DXF interoperability, producer qualification, or broader format support.
